description: Source code for the SimplePathBuilderDelegate class, which handles certificate path validation, signature algorithm acceptance, and public key validation within a certificate verification framework.

classes.name: SimplePathBuilderDelegate
classes.description: Handles certificate path validation, signature algorithm acceptance, and public key validation.

methods.name: CheckPathAfterVerification
methods.description: Performs post-verification checks on the certificate path; currently does nothing.

methods.name: IsDeadlineExpired
methods.description: Checks if the validation deadline has expired; always returns false.

methods.name: GetVerifyCache
methods.description: Returns the cache used for signature verification; currently returns nullptr.

methods.name: IsSignatureAlgorithmAcceptable
methods.description: Determines if a signature algorithm is acceptable based on the digest policy.

methods.name: IsPublicKeyAcceptable
methods.description: Validates if a public key is acceptable based on its type and parameters.
